examples.extractFromTextPrompt:
Extract revenue growth data from this text:

Business Highlights

Vanture Cloud revenue was $18.2 billion and increased 22% (up 20% in constant currency), and commercial remaining performance obligation increased 34% to $210 billion.

Revenue in Digital Workspace was $12.6 billion and increased 13% (up 11% in constant currency), with the following business highlights:

·        Workspace Commercial cloud revenue increased 15% (up 12% in constant currency)

·        Workspace Consumer cloud revenue increased 9% (up 8% in constant currency)

·        ConnectHub revenue increased 7% (up 6% in constant currency)

·        FlowSuite revenue increased 12% (up 10% in constant currency)

Revenue in Intelligent Platform was $15.4 billion and increased 27% (up 25% in constant currency), with the following business highlights:

·        Vanture Cloud and other platform services revenue increased 33% (up 31% in constant currency)

Revenue in Consumer Devices was $6.1 billion and decreased 4%, with the following business highlights:

·        Device hardware and accessories revenue decreased 2% (relatively unchanged in constant currency)

·        Streaming content and services revenue decreased 3% (down 4% in constant currency)

·        Search and advertising revenue excluding traffic acquisition costs increased 8% (up 7% in constant currency)

Vanture returned $5.4 billion to shareholders in the form of dividends and share repurchases in the second quarter of fiscal year 2026, an increase of 18% compared to the second quarter of fiscal year 2025.
